anchor_value: subtotal rows are not issuer positions

findings.detail: A numeric subtotal row with no company or investment type was emitted as a holding, producing a missing issuer_name failure.

rationale: Class 1 source confirmation shows that the missing issuer_name is not a legitimate blank on a position. Table 9 row 15 has blank company, investment type, terms, rate, and maturity cells but contains aggregate principal/cost/percentage/fair-value amounts immediately after the Automobiles & Components positions. It is a subtotal row that should not have entered private_markets_holdings; the 71 C201 failures therefore reflect a real subtotal-filtering extraction defect. No aggregate valuation anchor was needed for this required-field adjudication.
